262: fn fields(layout: Layout, scale: f64) -> [Vec<Complex64>; 3] {
263:     let mut result = std::array::from_fn(|_| vec![Complex64::new(0.0, 0.0); layout.half_len()]);
264:     for (axis, component) in result.iter_mut().enumerate() {
265:         component[0] = Complex64::new(scale * (axis + 1) as f64, 0.0);
266:         let a = layout.index([1, 0, 0]).unwrap();
267:         let b = layout.index([layout.dimensions()[0] - 1, 0, 0]).unwrap();
268:         component[a] = Complex64::new(scale, scale * 0.25);
269:         component[b] = component[a].conj();
270:     }
271:     result
272: }

278: fn hermitian_mode(
279:     layout: Layout,
280:     fields: &mut [Vec<Complex64>; 3],
281:     mode: [isize; 3],
282:     values: [Complex64; 3],
283: ) {
284:     for (mode, values) in [
285:         (mode, values),
286:         (mode.map(|m| -m), values.map(|value| value.conj())),
287:     ] {
288:         let (index, conjugate) = layout.locate(mode).unwrap();
289:         for (component, value) in fields.iter_mut().zip(values) {
290:             component[index] = if conjugate { value.conj() } else { value };
291:         }
292:     }
293: }

649: fn encode(manifest: &Manifest, fields: &[Vec<Complex64>; 3]) -> Vec<u8> {
650:     let mut bytes = b"P10AVXSNAP1\0".to_vec();
651:     bytes.extend_from_slice(&(manifest.identity.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
652:     bytes.extend_from_slice(manifest.identity.as_bytes());
653:     for value in [
654:         manifest.elapsed,
655:         manifest.target,
656:         manifest.epoch,
657:         manifest.accepted_steps,
658:     ] {
659:         bytes.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
660:     }
661:     let payload_start = bytes.len();
662:     for component in fields {
663:         for value in component {
664:             bytes.extend_from_slice(&value.re.to_bits().to_le_bytes());
665:             bytes.extend_from_slice(&value.im.to_bits().to_le_bytes());
666:         }
667:     }
668:     bytes.extend_from_slice(&Sha256::digest(&bytes[payload_start..]));
669:     bytes
670: }

398: fn verify_bounded_hash(

411:         if count == 0 {

419:     }

438:                 f64::from_bits(u64::from_le_bytes(bytes[8..].try_into().map_err(debug)?)),
439:             ));

456:     }

462:     }
463: 
464:     fn array<const N: usize>(&mut self) -> Result<[u8; N], String> {

468:     }
